row.scim_plan: Enterprise (per JumpCloud; not named on Egnyte pricing)
row.evidence: Egnyte documents SCIM 2.0 provisioning (Okta 'Egnyte SCIM 2.0' app, Entra connector), and JumpCloud's Egnyte guide requires 'an Egnyte user account with administrator permissions with an Enterprise subscription'.
row.notes: Plan gate comes from JumpCloud's IdP page, not Egnyte: Egnyte's pricing page and help centre never name a SCIM plan, so confidence is low and the 'Enterprise' plan is not mapped to a current tier (Business $22, Enterprise Lite $39, Elite $48, Ultimate quote; Team $10 for 1-10 users). SSO/SAML shows a check from Enterprise Lite up; the Business column shows an unexplained '$' marker in that row (likely a paid option). SCIM tokens come from Egnyte's token generator (scim-20.egnyte.com); the Entra endpoint /pubapi/scim/v2/azure-connector is Entra-only. Okta/Entra deprovisioning deactivates (Entra hard-deletes after permanent deletion). Public API (incl. SCIM-style /pubapi/v2/users and SCIM 1.1-style groups API) is not available on Trial, Legacy Office or Team plans, so api_tax is true.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: SSO row shows a '$' marker rather than a check; meaning not explained on the page. API eligibility inferred from the Getting Started exclusion list (Trial, Legacy Office, Team).

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.price_text: Contact us for a custom quote

scim.notes: JumpCloud's guide says SSO must be configured before SCIM; Egnyte's own docs do not state it generally.

auth.token_source: Egnyte SCIM token generator at https://scim-20.egnyte.com/ (sign in with domain admin)

deprovision.data_retained: User is deactivated, not deleted, and can be reactivated manually; Entra deletes the user only after permanent deletion in Entra (default 30 days after soft delete).

custom.how: Custom attributes cannot be set on create but can be sent with PATCH (Entra).

roles.how: userType attribute (admin, power, standard); defaults to power. Power-user custom roles cannot be set via Okta or Entra SCIM.

limitations.text: Entra connector URL (/pubapi/scim/v2/azure-connector) cannot be used with other identity providers.
Nested groups and users in nested groups are ignored by Entra provisioning.
Username changes are not supported for SAML/SSO users.
Okta and Entra SCIM cannot assign custom Power User roles.
Entra setup requires contacting Egnyte support first (per Microsoft tutorial).
Entra sync is one way and runs every 40 minutes.

capabilities.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via PATCH active; invite via sendInvite on create; roles via userType/role fields.

endpoints.purpose: Partially update a user (incl. active, userType, role)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event list has group events (group:create, group:delete, group:rename, group:add_members, group:remove_members, group:add_owner, group:remove_owner) but no user lifecycle events.

rate_limits.text: Standard API calls: 1,000 calls per day and 2 calls per second per token; Audit Reporting v2: 10 requests/minute, 100/hour.

limitations.text: API keys only for domain administrators; not available on Trial, Legacy Office or Team plans.
List Groups returns only custom groups, not Egnyte default groups.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

onelogin.notes: Egnyte's SSO article lists OneLogin as a supported SAML provider (no 'Import Existing Users' check); OneLogin's own page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: Active Directory via Egnyte AD Kit
fallbacks.notes: AD sync named on the pricing page (User Authentication (AD and SSO/SAML)).
